title: Westminster parliamentary constituency population estimates, mid-2021 and mid-2022
description: ONS small area population estimates for Westminster parliamentary constituencies in England and Wales, by single year of age and sex, on the constituencies in force from July 2024 and on those they replaced.

files.note: The mid-2021 and mid-2022 edition, released 19 March 2024, as published at https://www.ons.gov.uk/file?uri=/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/datasets/parliamentaryconstituencymidyearpopulationestimates/mid2021andmid2022/sapepconstablefinal.xlsx. The loader reads the Total column of the "Mid-2021 PCON 2025" and "Mid-2022 PCON 2025" sheets: 575 constituencies (543 English E14 codes, 32 Welsh W07 codes), all present in the July 2024 constituency boundary release. ONS labels them PCON 2025 because it adopted the codes in May 2025. The WPC 2022 sheets cover the constituencies these replaced and are not read. Official statistics in development, per the workbook's notes.
